query.text: 请看着我做这道菜，有做错或不卫生的行为请及时纠正我。
query.text_en: Please watch me prepare this dish and promptly correct any mistakes or unhygienic actions.

annotation.text_zh: 打完喷嚏后请先洗手，不要用手接触调料。
annotation.text_en: Please wash your hands after sneezing before touching the seasonings.
